description: Look up a Gnosis transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in xDAI, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use gnosis_receipt, for emitted events gnosis_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x2b56c1dabbef9c9a07d0f94c6ff931c3e1f93cc398fa06296ff79770d4a4487f. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: gnosis_tx
title: Gnosis transaction
